name: MiniMax-H3 Character Swap LoRA - Workflow
description: Swap one character in a clip for a reference character

paragraphs: A demo of akatz-ai/MiniMax-H3-Character-Swap-LoRA, Akatz Labs' experimental character-replacement adapter for MiniMax-H3's ref2va partition. Hand it a scene clip and a character reference, name who to replace, and it puts the reference character into the shot — identity, outfit and art style carried over — while the background, camera, lighting and everyone else stay where they were. Video and its synchronized soundtrack come out of a single denoising pass.

This Space runs on gradio's gr.Workflow node canvas (it supersedes the retired Blocks-UI Space akhaliq/minimax-h3-character-swap-lora). The prompt, the scene clip, the character reference and the advanced knobs are reference nodes wired into the bound swap function node, which runs the request directly on this Space's own ZeroGPU worker — the same generate pipeline the /generate API endpoint serves, with the same per-request GPU booking, no gradioclient self-call in between — and the result lands in the output subject. The Space's owner can edit and save the graph on the canvas…
